name: BarBrain Inventory API
description:
The BarBrain Inventory API allows authorized external systems to retrieve detailed 
inventory data for a company. This is useful for:
- Daily inventory sync to external systems
- Automated reporting and analytics
- Integration with accounting software
- Data backup and archiving
